rules.content:
-- Detect unlimited token approvals to contracts not in verified/whitelist
SELECT
    tx_hash,
    block_timestamp,
    from_address AS victim_wallet,
    to_address AS token_contract,
    CAST(CONV(SUBSTRING(input_data, 75, 64), 16, 10) AS DECIMAL) AS approval_amount,
    CONCAT('0x', SUBSTRING(input_data, 35, 40)) AS spender_address
FROM ethereum.transactions
WHERE SUBSTRING(input_data, 1, 10) = '0x095ea7b3'  -- approve() function selector
  AND SUBSTRING(input_data, 75, 64) = 'ffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffffff'  -- unlimited approval
  AND CONCAT('0x', SUBSTRING(input_data, 35, 40)) NOT IN (SELECT address FROM verified_contracts)
  AND block_timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
ORDER BY block_timestamp DESC;
rules.title: On-Chain Query — Unlimited ERC-20 Approval to Unverified Contract (Phase 2)

rules.content:
title: Permit2 Batch Transfer Following New Permit Signature
status: experimental
description: Detects batch token transfers via Permit2 contract that follow a newly submitted permit signature, indicative of wallet drainer execution.
logsource:
    product: blockchain_monitoring
    service: ethereum
detection:
    selection_permit2:
        contract_address: "0x000000000022d473030f116ddee9f6b43ac78ba3"  # Canonical Permit2
        method: "permitBatchTransferFrom"
    filter_value:
        total_value_usd|gte: 1000
    condition: selection_permit2 and filter_value
level: critical
tags:
    - fraud.wallet_drainer
    - cfpf.phase4.execution
rules.title: Sigma — Permit2 Batch Transfer Anomaly (Phase 4)

rules.content:
index=domain_monitoring sourcetype=cert_transparency
| search domain="*airdrop*" OR domain="*claim*" OR domain="*mint*" OR domain="*drop*"
| eval age_hours=round((now() - registration_epoch) / 3600, 1)
| where age_hours < 48
| lookup verified_web3_domains domain AS domain OUTPUT is_legitimate
| where isnull(is_legitimate) OR is_legitimate="false"
| table domain, registration_date, age_hours, registrar, hosting_ip, ssl_issuer
| sort age_hours
rules.title: Splunk — Phishing Domain Detection for Web3 Projects (Phase 1)
